Repeated rows keep all other exact RGB counts unchanged; canonical width and widget mode avoid resampling/registration.

Same exact RGB support on both sides, but swap [600,600,1,1] to [1,1,600,600] pixel weights within each of six four-color groups; 232 seeded extra colors and 236 tail pixels. Same exact RGB support on both sides, but swap [600,600,1,1] to [1,1,600,600] pixel weights within each of six four-color groups; 232 seeded extra colors and 236 tail pixels. Add one to the red channel of the last pixel on both sides, crossing 256 to 257 colors. The real mass mismatch must remain visible without invented missing/added colors; 768x10 widget inputs avoid resampling and registration.

Existing perceptual counterparts must not become a false missing/added accent at the shortlist cutoff; 768x100 widget inputs avoid resampling and registration.
